source.ten: Reference compilation (editorial draft, 2026) following the Balliett–Jordan tradition and common numerology books
source.luu_y: Draft shown by decision of the project owner (2026-09-30); a status column allows gradual review. A cultural reference, not a forecast.

khoi_xuong.muon: to decide for yourself, go first and see that you made something happen
khoi_xuong.bi_hieu_lam: cold, only focused on the goal, hard to approach
khoi_xuong.can: to be trusted with real authority and recognised for results

ket_noi.muon: to belong, to be needed and to see the people around you doing well
ket_noi.bieu_hien: approachable, thoughtful, quick to give way
ket_noi.bi_hieu_lam: a pushover with no opinion of your own, who says yes to everyone
ket_noi.can: warm appreciation and relationships that give back as much as they take

bieu_dat.muon: to express yourself freely, try new things and live in colour
bieu_dat.bi_hieu_lam: shallow, quick to get bored, inconsistent
bieu_dat.can: room to create and change without being boxed in

nen_tang.muon: things to be solid and planned, and to see work through to the end
nen_tang.can: stability, clear processes and time to do things properly

chiem_nghiem.muon: to understand things to the root and to have quiet time of your own to think
chiem_nghiem.bieu_hien: quiet, private, observing more than talking
chiem_nghiem.bi_hieu_lam: distant, hard to read, a little aloof
chiem_nghiem.can: time alone and people who respect your depth

khoi_xuong|khoi_xuong.doc: Inside and outside share the same decisive rhythm: people see exactly what you want.
khoi_xuong|khoi_xuong.cach_noi_ro: Because you rarely voice your feelings, make a habit of asking others what they need before you settle a shared decision.
khoi_xuong|khoi_xuong.khi_hoa: A strong pull: you say it and do it, and people find it easy to follow you.

ket_noi|khoi_xuong.doc: One side wants to keep the peace, the other wants to get to the result fast — you often swing between giving way and deciding.
ket_noi|khoi_xuong.cach_noi_ro: Say both things out loud: 'I want everyone to be okay, and I also need to settle this today.'
ket_noi|khoi_xuong.khi_hoa: A leader who listens — deciding quickly without anyone feeling pushed aside.

bieu_dat|khoi_xuong.doc: One side wants to be in charge, the other wants the freedom to try new things — you easily start several things at once.
bieu_dat|khoi_xuong.cach_noi_ro: Before opening something new, tell the people you work with which task you will finish first.
bieu_dat|khoi_xuong.khi_hoa: An initiator with charm — opening the way and getting others excited to follow.

khoi_xuong|nen_tang.doc: One side wants to go first, the other wants each step to be safe — you may hold yourself back for fear of getting it wrong.
khoi_xuong|nen_tang.cach_noi_ro: Break the work into small milestones: decide the direction quickly, take care over the execution.
khoi_xuong|nen_tang.khi_hoa: Someone who can build big things: vision plus a process to see it through.

chiem_nghiem|khoi_xuong.doc: One side wants to make the call, the other wants to understand it to the root — you often think for a long time, then act very fast.
chiem_nghiem|khoi_xuong.cach_noi_ro: Let people know you are weighing things up and when you will answer, so your silence is not taken as a brush-off.
chiem_nghiem|khoi_xuong.khi_hoa: A thoughtful decision-maker: rarely wrong, because you have thought it through.

ket_noi|ket_noi.doc: Inside and outside both turn towards people: others see exactly how caring you are.
ket_noi|ket_noi.cach_noi_ro: Because everyone comes to you, practise saying 'I can't take this one on' without a long explanation.
ket_noi|ket_noi.khi_hoa: The person a group relies on — keeping people together and keeping the mood good.

bieu_dat|ket_noi.doc: One side wants closeness, the other needs room to roam — you may feel guilty when you want to go your own way.
bieu_dat|ket_noi.cach_noi_ro: Tell the people close to you in advance when you need time to yourself, so they do not read it as you pulling away.
bieu_dat|ket_noi.khi_hoa: A charming connector — bringing joy into your relationships.

ket_noi|nen_tang.doc: One side puts people first, the other puts principles first — you easily blame yourself when you have to say 'no' because of a rule.
ket_noi|nen_tang.cach_noi_ro: Separate the two: 'I care about you, and I still have to keep to this rule.'
ket_noi|nen_tang.khi_hoa: Someone trusted both personally and professionally — caring, with clear standards.

chiem_nghiem|ket_noi.doc: One side wants to be close to people, the other needs to be alone — others find it hard to guess when you want to be checked on.
chiem_nghiem|ket_noi.cach_noi_ro: Have a familiar line ready: 'I need a quiet evening — let's talk tomorrow.'
chiem_nghiem|ket_noi.khi_hoa: Someone who truly understands — listening deeply and reading people better than they expect.

bieu_dat|bieu_dat.doc: Inside and outside share the same free, creative rhythm: people see your energy exactly as it is.
bieu_dat|bieu_dat.cach_noi_ro: Because you get enthusiastic easily, be clear about which things you are committing to and which you are only toying with.
bieu_dat|bieu_dat.khi_hoa: A source of inspiration — making everything around you feel fresh.

bieu_dat|nen_tang.doc: One side wants change, the other wants stability — you may feel bored by routine and afraid of losing your footing at the same time.
bieu_dat|nen_tang.cach_noi_ro: Keep one fixed base (your schedule, your finances) and let yourself experiment with the rest.
bieu_dat|nen_tang.khi_hoa: A disciplined creator — new ideas that still turn into finished work.

bieu_dat|chiem_nghiem.doc: One side wants to show itself, the other wants to withdraw — people see you sometimes very bright, sometimes very closed.
bieu_dat|chiem_nghiem.cach_noi_ro: Give people a heads-up about your rhythm: 'I'm a bit quiet today — it's not about anyone.'
bieu_dat|chiem_nghiem.khi_hoa: A storyteller with depth — you speak well because you have thought it through.

nen_tang|nen_tang.doc: Inside and outside share the same steady rhythm: people see exactly how dependable you are.
nen_tang|nen_tang.cach_noi_ro: Because you rarely show your feelings, now and then say out loud what you value in other people.
nen_tang|nen_tang.khi_hoa: A pillar — whatever is handed to you is in safe hands.

chiem_nghiem|nen_tang.doc: Both sides like to be thorough — you easily keep the work to yourself because you want to be sure before sharing.
chiem_nghiem|nen_tang.cach_noi_ro: Share a rough draft earlier than you would like; people need to know where you are heading.
chiem_nghiem|nen_tang.khi_hoa: A true specialist — deep understanding and work done properly.

chiem_nghiem|chiem_nghiem.doc: Inside and outside both turn towards depth: people see exactly how calm and reflective you are.
chiem_nghiem|chiem_nghiem.cach_noi_ro: Because you say little, choose one or two people to share what you are thinking with — do not keep everything in your head.
chiem_nghiem|chiem_nghiem.khi_hoa: Someone with a mind of their own — a point of view few people have.

hop_de: meeting people and widening your circle
taking stock before a new cycle

nam_doc_thang.1: A year of beginnings: any month suits planting something new; a "closing" month this year is about clearing space for the new, not giving up.
nam_doc_thang.2: A year of nurturing: a "starting" month suits beginning small and together with others; things tend to move slowly, so do not force the pace.
nam_doc_thang.3: A year of expression: a "change" month suits trying a new role at a manageable level; keep your promises within what you can do.
nam_doc_thang.4: A year of building foundations: a "starting" month suits opening something with a clear plan; think big changes through carefully before making them.
nam_doc_thang.5: A year of change: starting and changing-job months flow very easily; "building" and "slowing down" months help you keep your direction amid all the change.
nam_doc_thang.6: A year of commitment: family matters and commitments come first; in a "change" month, take the people close to you into account.
nam_doc_thang.7: A year of slowing down: a "starting" month suits learning and preparing more than a big launch; in a "money" month, protecting what you have comes before taking risks.
nam_doc_thang.8: A year of harvest: "money" months are the highlight of the year; "slowing down" months keep you from overdoing it.
nam_doc_thang.9: A year of closing: a "starting" month this year suits sketching and preparing; leave big commitments for the year of beginnings (from January next year).

ghi_chu_thang_1: Your personal month is your personal year plus the month number, so from January the numbers follow the new personal year — which is why the rhythm around the turn of the calendar year can repeat.
